svg.title: Potential energy vs. internuclear distance
svg.desc: Potential energy against the distance between two nuclei, for a single and a double bond. Each curve rises steeply at short distance, passes through a minimum, and approaches zero at large separation. The double-bond curve has its minimum at a shorter distance and a deeper well than the single bond. Illustrative data.
svg.text: The minimum gives the bond length; the well depth gives the bond energy
Higher bond order: shorter bond, deeper well.
